context_stem: Audits: Develop plans to (1) audit and assess the design and implementation of the security program...
excerpt: We expect this to include independent validation of threat modeling and risk assessment results; a sampling-based audit of the operating effectiveness of the defined controls; periodic, broadly scoped, and independent testing with expert red-teamers who are industry-renowned and have been recognized in competitive challenges.
paraphrase: The audit is expected to include independent validation of threat models, sampling-based control audits, and periodic independent testing by renowned expert red-teamers.

context_stem: To make the required showing, we will need to satisfy the following criteria:
excerpt: Third-party environments: Document how all relevant models will meet the criteria above, even if they are deployed in a third-party partner's environment that may have a different set of safeguards.
paraphrase: Anthropic must document how models meet the above security criteria even when deployed in third-party partner environments with different safeguards.

excerpt: If, after the evaluations above, we determine that we have met the ASL-3 Required Safeguards, then we may proceed with deploying and training models above the Capability Threshold, provided we have also conducted a follow-up capability assessment.
paraphrase: If ASL-3 Required Safeguards are confirmed met, Anthropic may proceed with training/deploying models above the Capability Threshold, contingent on a follow-up capability assessment.

excerpt: The process for determining whether we have met the ASL-3 Required Safeguards is as follows:
paraphrase: Anthropic outlines the process for determining ASL-3 Required Safeguards compliance below.

context_stem: The process for determining whether we have met the ASL-3 Required Safeguards is as follows:
excerpt: First, we will compile a Safeguards Report for each Required Safeguard that documents our implementation of the measures above, makes an affirmative case for why we have satisfied them, and advances recommendations on deployment decisions.
paraphrase: Anthropic will first compile a Safeguards Report per Required Safeguard documenting implementation, justifying compliance, and recommending deployment decisions.

context_stem: The process for determining whether we have met the ASL-3 Required Safeguards is as follows:
excerpt: The Safeguards Report(s) will be escalated to the CEO and the Responsible Scaling Officer, who will (1) make the ultimate determination as to whether we have satisfied the Required Safeguards and (2) decide any deployment-related issues.
paraphrase: Safeguards Reports go to the CEO and Responsible Scaling Officer, who determine compliance and decide deployment issues.

context_stem: The process for determining whether we have met the ASL-3 Required Safeguards is as follows:
excerpt: In general, as noted in Sections 7.1.4 and 7.2.2, we will solicit both internal and external expert feedback on the report as well as the CEO and RSO's conclusions to inform future refinements to our methodology.
paraphrase: Anthropic will generally seek internal and external expert feedback on the report and leadership conclusions to refine methodology.

context_stem: In general...we will solicit both internal and external expert feedback...
excerpt: For high-stakes issues, however, the CEO and RSO will likely solicit internal and external feedback on the report prior to making any decisions.
paraphrase: For high-stakes issues, the CEO and RSO will likely gather feedback before deciding.

context_stem: The process for determining whether we have met the ASL-3 Required Safeguards is as follows:
excerpt: If the CEO and RSO decide to proceed with deployment and training, they will share their decision–as well as the underlying Capability Report, internal feedback, and any external feedback–with the Board of Directors and the Long-Term Benefit Trust before moving forward.
paraphrase: If deployment/training is approved, the CEO and RSO will share the decision and supporting materials with the Board and the Long-Term Benefit Trust beforehand.

context_stem: The process for determining whether we have met the ASL-3 Required Safeguards is as follows:
excerpt: After the ASL-3 Required Safeguards are approved, they will be revisited and re-approved at least annually to re-affirm their suitability and sound implementation.
paraphrase: Approved ASL-3 Required Safeguards will be reviewed and re-approved at least once a year.

excerpt: If, however, we are unable to make the showing required above, we will restrict model deployment and further scaling.
paraphrase: If Anthropic cannot demonstrate compliance, it will restrict model deployment and further scaling.

excerpt: In parallel with upgrading a model to the ASL-3 Required Safeguards, we will conduct a follow-up capability assessment to determine that the model's capability falls sufficiently far away from the Capability Thresholds that would trigger ASL-4 Required Safeguards.
paraphrase: Alongside upgrading to ASL-3 Required Safeguards, Anthropic will assess whether model capability is sufficiently distant from ASL-4-triggering thresholds.

excerpt: We will update this policy with the Capability Thresholds for the ASL-4 Required Safeguards.
paraphrase: Anthropic will update the policy to include Capability Thresholds for ASL-4 Required Safeguards.

excerpt: We are currently working on defining any further Capability Thresholds that would mandate ASL-4 Required Safeguards.
paraphrase: Anthropic is currently working to define additional Capability Thresholds that would require ASL-4 Required Safeguards.

excerpt: Our update may not include all possible risks; we will prioritize capabilities that are likely to emerge earlier in frontier models.
paraphrase: The future update may not cover every risk, and Anthropic will prioritize capabilities expected to emerge earlier in frontier models.
